annotations.text: Run mode, strip model: each X-Touch strip is bound to one group. Fader = dimmer, select button = the desk's selection (LED lit while selected), encoder = the lit Encoder bank's property, flash button derived. Right block: selection encoders drive whatever is selected (colour reads mixed). Row 3 mixes stack transport, tap, template presses (Red lit: covers the selection), a position template and a bound Look. Blackout / GM toolbar gone.

Edit bindings: the library takes the inspector's place. A group or fixture ROW dropped on a strip binds the whole strip (here 'Side wash' mid-drag over strip 7). A CHIP binds one control: properties, Selection-relative properties, Encoder bank pages, template Press, Look Apply, busk pads and pages, desk actions. Fixed and strip bindings coexist.

Backend implied: a desk-side selection shared by the busk view and the surface; strip / selectionProperty / encoderBank / select / applyLook / pressTemplate / pressPad / buskPage binding targets; and one keyed surfaceControls.state stream for fader position, touch, LED and ring state. Plan document to follow.
